summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, permit only bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, and claims boundaries, and continue read-only evidence capture. Do not access credentials or private containers, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix covering access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Record dated evidence, affected scope, owners, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications. Do not treat missing telemetry as a pass or zero.
